structures.note: Long 60C / short 65C. Both legs on observed OI (60C 514, 65C 874). 60.00 = phase-3 put_wall_support; 65.00 = call_wall_resistance AND phase-4 max-pain AND the strike where a Sep-18 62.5/65 credit call spread was sold. Quotes 2026-07-31: 60C 4.60/4.96, 65C 2.16/2.42; mid-to-mid debit 2.49, worst-case 2.80. Max gain 2.40, payoff 0.92:1. N4: target 65.00 = +4.37% = 0.48x the priced 9.098% move (not rich), BUT the 5.00 width is narrower than the 5.67 expected move - deliberate, since 64.68-65.00 is a stacked wall, at the cost of being capped in a SAMR gap. Entered at spot this is a losing proposition (raw Kelly -0.085); it works only from the 60.00 trigger.

Short 55P / long 50P. Quotes 2026-07-31: 55P bid 0.89, 50P ask 0.46. Sells the zone directly beneath phase-2's 58.44-59.34 accumulation shelf and above phase-1's 52.50 flow-anchored floor - same directional side as the only opening position on the board, but with defined risk. Observed OI: 55P 686, 50P 1,307. N4 PASSES: the 55.00 short strike is -11.7% from spot, below the 56.61 one-expected-move floor, so a single expected-move gap does not breach it. Weakness: 0.43 credit against 4.57 risk is 9.4% return on risk for 21 days - the market is not paying you to underwrite this floor.

REJECTED. Sep-18 62.5C ask 5.24 + 62.5P ask 5.20 = 10.44 debit; breakevens 52.06/72.94 require a +/-16.76% move = 1.84x the front-expiry priced move, beyond the ~1.5x richness threshold. Independently rejected by phase-8b, where the defender conceded ten-session realized vol (55.53%) sits AT implied (55.90%) so the cheap-vol premise fails, and the SAMR catalyst is undated with formal guidance of early calendar 2027 - 49 days of theta on an unscheduled ruling. A short-put risk reversal was also ruled out: naked short premium is disallowed by the sizing rubric.

key_risks: Vol is fairly priced, not cheap - trailing-10-session realized 55.53% vs iv30d 55.90% [HIST:realized_decomp DUCKDB] - so any long-vol expression pays theta on an UNDATED SAMR decision whose formal guidance is early calendar 2027 [MACRO:SWKS_QRVO_merger_2026-07-28], with no measured base rate to justify it (win_rate_source null, win_rate_n 0 [HIST:signal_backtest]). This is phase-8b's strongest_bear_point.

The 21.93% float short (~32.85M shares, 5.77 days to cover) is the merger-arb hedge and its unwind is INVERTED: on deal CLOSE the arb delivers received shares with no market buying, so there is no squeeze; only a deal BREAK forces ~32.9M shares of open-market covering - and that arrives with $2B of stranded debt and no synergies, amplified by dealers short gamma at spot (62.5 = -448,437 GEX) [SENT:short_float fz semi-monthly] [STRUCT:gex].

The $60-65 box is a MAP of supply and demand, not a MECHANISM - phase-4 gex.regime is NEGATIVE with spot on the most negative per-strike GEX on the board, so dealers amplify moves off 62.50 rather than damping them; nothing holds price inside the box except the willingness of participants who have already been selling [STRUCT:gex].

The 3,333-lot short-put floor at 52.50 is UNCONFIRMED as open interest - the OI dataset is lagged one session (last_date 2026-07-30 / curr_date 2026-07-31), so it can only be verified in the 2026-08-03 file, which is beyond this snapshot [OI:lag DUCKDB].
